No Hakata Ming menu PDF, ordering page or verified branch photo found. Daimyo/Tenjin dishes, prices, photos and Michelin recognition are not transferred. Employee meal/discount is not a customer offer. Staff shifts and landlord general hours are not branch service hours. Revisit when operator publishes branch menu and actual gallery.
